# OTHER SIDE — Men's Fashion E-Commerce (llms.txt)

> Two sides. One identity. Premium men's streetwear — Otherside Men catalog.

## About
OTHER SIDE is a men-only fashion e-commerce store (Lebanon / worldwide shipping). Catalog of 791+ looks imported from Otherside Men Instagram archive.

## Public pages
- Home: /
- Shop (791 products, infinite scroll): /shop
- Product detail: /product/:slug
- Cart: /cart (checkout requires sign-in)
- Account: /login, /signup, /account
- Legal: /privacy, /terms, /cookies, /security-policy, /shipping, /faq, /contact, /about

## Admin (disallow bots)
- /admin — requires admin role (not indexed)

## Product data
- Categories: looks, tops, bottoms, outerwear, footwear, accessories
- Images: static WebP at /images/catalog/{category}/{slug}.webp (bundled with site CDN)
- Prices in USD; payments: COD, WhatsApp, Whish Pay (Lebanon)

## API (backend, not for crawling)
- Base: same-origin `/api` (Cloudflare Pages proxy to Workers API)
- Health: GET /api/health
- Auth: email/password + Google OAuth

## Tech stack
- Frontend: React 19, Vite, Tailwind v4, Cloudflare Pages
- Backend: Express, MongoDB Atlas, Upstash Redis
- Security: CSRF, JWT httpOnly cookies, rate limits, helmet headers

## Contact
- Security: /.well-known/security.txt
- Support: /contact
